title: LLM基准测试设计趋势的系统性映射研究
summary: 该研究系统分析了2022至2026年间14,767篇LLM评估相关论文，考察目标系统、评估材料与评分机制的变化。发现评估日益强调行动、交互与专业应用，LLM参与评分增长，但模型生成材料未持续增加，引发评估独立性质疑。
summary_en: This study systematically maps 14,767 papers introducing or updating LLM evaluation resources from 2022 to 2026, examining changes in target systems, evaluation materials, and scoring mechanisms. It finds growing emphasis on action, interaction, and professional applications, with LLM-based scoring increasing while model-generated materials show no sustained growth, raising questions about evaluation independence.
